variation: Standing upright with two independent high-cable handles
setup: Use two high cable handles; start with a light load.
Stand tall with feet planted and handles around shoulder height.
Keep a small, steady bend in both elbows.

advice.tip: Pull through your upper arms while keeping your torso steady.
commonMistakes: Turning the movement into an elbow-bending pulldown.
Leaning back or swinging to move the load.
Letting the weight stacks drop on the return.
